candidate.title: DR-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina DR-Seq schematic, resolved against the Dey et al. 2015 implementation: joint single-cell genomic-DNA/cDNA amplification before splitting, followed by separate transcriptome and genome library routes and sequencing. The far-left Genome DNA and mRNA sequencing (DR-Seq) motif identifies the analytes; the main workflow begins at the next single-cell icon. Upper and lower final lines represent separate library interfaces under one Sequence caption. Text resolves broad amplification blocks without expanding routine unshown processing. Neither the MALBAC component comparison nor the background G&T-seq citation adds a target method.
